_comment: Copy to %LOCALAPPDATA%\xtp\cloud.json (or set XTP_CLOUD_CONFIG), outside the repository, and fill in the <...> values. See docs/dev/cloud-setup.md. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_zones: Zones tried in order when the VM is created; the first with capacity wins. A zone of another region works, but then the VM reads the bucket across regions.
gameDir: <path to your own dump of the title, e.g. D:\xtp-data\game>
_goldenDir: Optional: an XTP data folder (saves, settings) that game runs start from; copied for each run, never written. Leave empty for none.
